title: Zoom Upbeat Q1 Results, Joins Lionsgate Studios, Ross Stores And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Friday
text: Zoom Communications Inc shares rise after strong financial results and increased buyback authorization. Other big gainers include IMRX, INFQ, ASMB, IMAX, RGTI, HLIT, DELL, EL, GSIT, ELVR, and HPQ.
author: avi kapoor
teaser: Zoom Communications Inc shares rise after strong financial results and increased buyback authorization. Other big gainers include IMRX, INFQ, ASMB, IMAX, RGTI, HLIT, DELL, EL, GSIT, ELVR, and HPQ.
body_text:
U.S. stocks were higher, with the Dow Jones index gaining over 300 points on Friday.

Shares of Zoom Communications Inc (NASDAQ:ZM) rose sharply after the company reported better-than-expected first-quarter financial results and raised its FY27 guidance above estimates. Also, the company announced its board authorized the repurchase of an additional $1.0 billion of its outstanding Class A common stock.

Zoom reported revenue of $1.24 billion for the first quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $1.22 billion. The company posted first-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.55 per share, beating analyst estimates of $1.42 per share, according to Benzinga Pro.

Zoom shares jumped 11.6% to $107.98 on Friday.

Here are some other big stocks recording gains in today’s session.

Immuneering Corp (NASDAQ:IMRX) shares jumped 27.1% to $6.63 after the company announced a 17.3-month median overall survival in first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer patients treated in its Phase 2a clinical trial evaluating atebimetinib.

Infleqtion inc (NYSE:INFQ) gained 19.3% to $17.53.

Assembly Biosciences Inc (NASDAQ:ASMB) gained 17.5% to $31.15 after the company announced plans to expand the clinical development of ABI-6250. The company priced its $100 million offering of 3,358,602 shares at $26.50 per share.

Imax Corp (NYSE:IMAX) gained 15.7% to $39.23 following reports suggesting the company is exploring a sale.

Rigetti Computing Inc (NASDAQ:RGTI) gained 13.8% to $25.10.

Harmonic Inc (NASDAQ:HLIT) gained 13.5% to $14.42.

Dell Technologies Inc (NYSE:DELL) rose 12.4% to $284.18.

Estee Lauder Companies Inc (NYSE:EL) shares jumped 12% to $88.01 after the company announced it terminated discussions regarding a potential business combination with Puig.

GSI Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:GSIT) gained 11.7% to $10.34.

Elevra Lithium Limited (NASDAQ:ELVR) gained 11.3% to $96.61.

HP Inc (NYSE:HPQ) gained 11.1% to $24.36.

Lionsgate Studios Corp (NYSE:LION) gained 10.3% to $14.23 following upbeat quarterly earnings.

Navitas Semiconductor Corp (NASDAQ:NVTS) jumped 10.2% to $26.86.

Vishay Intertechnology Inc (NYSE:VSH) gained 9.5% to $46.18.

AST SpaceMobile Inc (NASDAQ:ASTS) rose 9.2% to $105.04.

BlackBerry Ltd (NYSE:BB) shares climbed 9.1% to $7.26.

NetApp Inc (NASDAQ:NTAP) gained 8.7% to $134.91.

Wolfspeed Inc (NYSE:WOLF) gained 8.7% to $75.63.

Intuitive Machines Inc (NASDAQ:LUNR) rose 7.8% to $36.92.

Ross Stores Inc (NASDAQ:ROST) gained 6.8% to $232.04 after the company reported better-than-expected first-quarter financial results and raised its FY26 GAAP EPS guidance above estimates.

Photo via Shutterstock
